title: National Energy Customer Framework adopted (Tasmania)
summary: Tasmania applied the National Energy Retail Law and Rules to electricity from 1 July 2012; gas retail stayed under state law.

direction_rationale: Adopting the National Energy Retail Law replaces state retailer licences with one AER authorisation that is valid in every participating jurisdiction, lowering the cost of entering several markets, and harmonises customer protections.

assessment.summary: Adopting the National Energy Retail Law replaced a state retailer licence with one national authorisation and common customer rules. In Tasmania it covers electricity only. It lowers the cost for a retailer of serving customers in several states.

marks.reason: One national retailer authorisation and common customer protections replace state regimes.
Retailers operating in several states comply with one framework instead of several.
